Burnham to unveil cost-of-living package on becoming PM.
- Burnham set to announce a cost-of-living package as one of his initial acts as PM.
- Plans reportedly include measures to reduce energy bills: making heat pumps cheaper than gas boilers, and cutting VAT on energy.
- PM expected Monday; rapid introduction of new policies anticipated.
- Cabinet speculation: Shabana Mahmood, Wes Streeting, Angela Rayner frequently mentioned for significant roles.
- Sources close to Angela Rayner have DISMISSED reports she will take on Health Secretary.
